kpis.description_fr: NIM consolidé FY3/25 (mars 2025). Expansion via sortie taux zéro BoJ. Inférieur à US/EU pairs en absolu mais momentum positif.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated NIM FY3/25 (March 2025). Expansion via BoJ zero-rate exit. Below US/EU peers in absolute terms but positive momentum.

kpis.description_fr: Encours prêts consolidés (yens trillion) FY3/25. #1 banque Japon, large diversification corporate/retail/global.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated loan book (trillion yen) FY3/25. #1 Japan bank, broad corporate/retail/global diversification.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio CET1 FY3/25. Solide vs exigence 9.6%. Marge de manœuvre pour buybacks (programme 400Md¥ en cours).
kpis.description_en: FY3/25 CET1 ratio. Solid vs 9.6% requirement. Room for buybacks (¥400Bn program in progress).

kpis.description_fr: Participation Morgan Stanley (24% au coût, 22.7% via dilution) FY3/25. Contribution ~30% revenu net via equity method. Joyau bilan.
kpis.description_en: Morgan Stanley stake (24% at cost, 22.7% post dilution) FY3/25. ~30% net income contribution via equity method. Balance sheet jewel.

kpis.description_fr: Bénéfice opérationnel net Global Markets FY3/25. Forte contribution trésorerie ALM + trading. Bénéficie hausse taux JGB.
kpis.description_en: Global Markets net operating profits FY3/25. Strong treasury ALM + trading contribution. JGB yield rise beneficiary.

kpis_story.description_fr: Mars 2024 fin politique taux 0 BoJ après 17 ans. Mars 2025 hausse à 0.5%. MUFG bénéficiaire majeur via réinvestissement portefeuille obligataire + spreads dépôt.
kpis_story.description_en: March 2024 BoJ zero-rate policy end after 17 years. March 2025 hike to 0.5%. MUFG major beneficiary via bond portfolio reinvestment + deposit spreads.

_notes: Japan largest bank. Source: 20-F FY3/25 filed Jul 2025.
